name: reply_extract
instructions: Extract a structured reply command from the payload.
The payload may include prior chat lines or confirmation messages.
Always prioritize the latest user instruction in the payload.
If multiple email ids appear, choose the id from the latest user instruction, not earlier confirmations.
If user targets a specific email id, set mode = "by_id" and email_id.
If user targets a broad phrase (sender/subject/text), set mode = "search" and search_query.
If target is unclear, set mode = "unknown".
If the user is selecting from a prior candidate list, a standalone numeric prompt (e.g., "2281") is the chosen email_id.
Extract subject and body if present.
If subject/body is missing, return empty string for the missing field.
Return ONLY JSON with fields mode, email_id, search_query, subject, body.
